prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. Robot will approach, check properties, take, and complete specific task for objects. Otherwise, scan and move randomly. list of available nodes: <Action ID = TakeObject    /> <Action ID = CheckObjectWeight    /> <Action ID = MoveBack    /> <Action ID = ScanAreaForObjects    /> <Action ID = MoveToRandomLocation    /> <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <SubTree ID = CompleteSpecificTask    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    /> <Sequence>     <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    />     <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> </Sequence> <Sequence>     <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    />     <Action ID = TakeObject    />     <Action ID = CheckObjectWeight    />     <SubTree ID = CompleteSpecificTask    />     <Action ID = MoveBack    /> </Sequence> <Fallback>     <Sequence>         <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    />         <Action ID = TakeObject    />         <Action ID = CheckObjectWeight    />         <SubTree ID = CompleteSpecificTask    />         <Action ID = MoveBack    />     </Sequence>     <Sequence>         <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    />         <Action ID = ApproachObject    />     </Sequence>     <Action ID = ScanAreaForObjects    />     <Action ID = MoveToRandomLocation    /> </Fallback>"
code:
SELECTOR
		SEQUENCE
				IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
				DO TakeObject
		ELSE
			DO CheckObjectWeight
			DO CompleteSpecificTask
			DO MoveBack
		END
		SEQUENCE
				IF IsObjectVisible? THEN
				DO ApproachObject
		END
		DO ScanAreaForObjects
		DO MoveToRandomLocation
	END
